Transport services — Poland & EU

Road freight with 3.5 t vans and trucks. Express, scheduled lanes, warehouse transfers.

Zamów wycenę

Scope

  • Domestic & international (PL & EU) — door‑to‑door, 24/7.
  • Express 3.5 t vans (FTL) — time‑critical, JIT.
  • Trucks (TIR) — 33 pallets, side/rear/top loading.
  • Warehouse transfers — e‑commerce, fulfillment, cross‑dock.
  • Plus: loading help, load securing, GPS tracking.

Service standard

One dispatcher, fast quotes (~15 min), POD/CMR and documents online.
